description: Post a balanced journal entry to the ledger. Debits must equal credits in account-space; otherwise the entry is rejected.

entryId.description: Optional client-supplied idempotency key. Auto-generated if omitted.

lineItems.description: 2+ lines summing to zero across DEBIT/CREDIT sides.

amount.description: Positive number; the side determines effect.

source.description: Origin tag: stripe, square, manual, etc.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 or epoch-millis. Defaults to now.

dimensions.description: Entry-level tags carried verbatim onto every ledger row (e.g. {"location": "2", "worker_id": ...}). location defaults to "1" (main) when omitted; statements slice by these.
